title: URL fetcher seam with SSRF guard (read-only)
description: UrlFetcher over Node 22 fetch(): GET-only (no other verb in the module). Controls: http(s)-only scheme allowlist; SSRF guard that resolves the host and REJECTS private/link-local/metadata ranges (10/8,172.16/12,192.168/16,127/8,169.254/16,::1,fc00::/7) before connect; AbortController 8s timeout; max-body ~1MB (truncate); descriptive User-Agent; redirect-follow <=3 and same-registrable-domain; best-effort robots/noai (record reason, do not hard-fail). Returns {ok, finalUrl, html, contentType} | {ok:false, reason}.
acceptanceCriteria: Rejects http://169.254.169.254 and private IPs before any network call
Rejects non-http(s) schemes
Enforces timeout and byte cap
Caps redirects and blocks cross-registrable-domain redirects
No POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE code path exists (read-only structural)
urlFetch-ssrf.test.ts covers each rejection

title: IntentMatrix builder (pure coverage contract)
description: PURE: given BrandBrief + GenOptions, build IntentCell[] across language x funnel_stage x intent_type. Language share proportional to detectedLanguages weight using the SAME ordering as sampling/languageWeight.ts sortByWeight. Within a language apply a fixed funnel mix (awareness 30 / consideration 35 / decision 35) biased toward category+comparison+alternative+useCase. Per-cell targetCount sums (with rounding) to the clamped requestedTotal. Deterministic + reproducible.

title: Density-tier mapping with hard core cap (pure)
description: PURE deterministic map (intent_type, funnel_stage, language weight, phrasing-sibling flag) -> density_tier. Decision-stage brand/comparison/alternative/category in top-weight languages -> core; consideration/useCase/mid -> secondary; awareness/attribute/low-weight + paraphrase siblings -> secondary or longtail. Enforce a HARD cap: core <=25% of total AND an absolute max core-count per language; overflow demotes deterministically to secondary. Lead phrasing variant may be core; siblings default secondary (NOT all longtail).
acceptanceCriteria: Core share never exceeds the cap on any input set
Tiers are reproducible for identical input
Paraphrase siblings are not all forced to longtail
densityMap.test.ts asserts core minority + cap enforcement

Flag low-resource languages (tl,vi,th) needs_native_review. Ledger each call. Reuse response_cache by (industryKey+language+intentCell) hash.

title: Dedup (normalized-exact + codepoint n-gram, CJK-safe)
description: PURE. Layer 1: NFC+lowercase+diacritic-fold+collapse-whitespace+strip-trailing-punct exact-collision drop (pre-empts question UNIQUE(customer_id,text,language)). Layer 2: per-language near-dup via codepoint 3-gram Jaccard (NOT token/word Jaccard — must work for ja/ko/zh/th); within a cluster keep the most natural representative + bounded siblings from distinct phrasingGroupIds. Cross-language dedup NOT applied. Stable ordering. NO embeddings.
acceptanceCriteria: Collapses CJK restatements on emora ja/ko/zh fixtures
Preserves genuine phrasing variants (distinct phrasingGroupId)
Keeps en and ja phrasings of the same intent (no cross-language collapse)
Exact normalization prevents UNIQUE collisions
